subject: general
question: What type of vegetation is found in North-Eastern India, parts of Western Ghats, Andaman and Nicobar, Upper Assam, lower slopes of Eastern Himalayas, Odisha, foothills of Himalayas, Bhabar and Terai regions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tropical evergreen forest**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Tropical evergreen forest** is found in North-Eastern India, parts of Western Ghats, Andaman and Nicobar, Upper Assam, lower slopes of Eastern Himalayas, Odisha, foothills of Himalayas, Bhabar and Terai regions.
 
• These forests are characterized by dense, multi-layered vegetation that remains green throughout the year.
